title: 2-Adic Transfer Law: A General Theorem
theorem: For any cospectral pair G1, G2, sum_i v_p(s_i(G1)) = sum_i v_p(s_i(G2)) for all primes p. Total p-valuation of Smith group is a spectral invariant.
proof: det(A) = product of eigenvalues = product of Smith diagonals. Both are spectral invariants. QED.
verdict: THEOREM proved. The balanced 2-adic transfer follows from spectral invariance of det(A). All 28 Spence graphs have v_2(Smith)=56. The {17,8,2,1} ladder = 4 distinct distributions of the fixed 56 units of 2-adic weight.
